subject: Tiered compliance blocks request + evidence lane
messages:
From: Aisha Morgan <aisha.morgan@northernbank.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: security-team@northernbank.com
Date: 2029-04-20T09:22:00-04:00
Subject: Request: SOC 2 / pen test / DPA review — scheduling and evidence handoff

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the intro yesterday. NorthernBank needs a focused intake for SOC 2 readiness, an upcoming pen test (3rd-party) scope check, and a DPA review with our legal team. To keep the work efficient, we prefer a tiered approach so our InfoSec, AppSec, and Legal teams can each get the right level of detail without repeating.

Can Redwood do three short coordinated blocks over two days? Something like:
- Block A (90m): Tech deep-dive — architecture, KV cache/data flow, audit logs (ours: AppSec + Infra)
- Block B (30m): Legal DPA review — data residency, subprocessors, retention
- Block C (60m): Ops runbook & pen-test handoff — staging access, test windows, point-of-contact

Prefer EU-friendly times (CEST). Our suggested windows: May 6 or May 8, afternoon CEST. We also have a short evidence checklist to share — can you confirm how you prefer to receive structured evidence? We can attach a CSV inventory.

Appreciate a couple of slot options (we'll try to keep it to a single NZ/UK cross-team runway).

Thanks,
Aisha Morgan
Security Program Manager — NorthernBank

Attachments: evidence_inventory_template.csv (stub)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Aisha Morgan <aisha.morgan@northernbank.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2029-04-20T12:08:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 / pen test / DPA review — scheduling and evidence handoff

Aisha — thanks, this makes sense and a tiered cadence is exactly what we recommend.

Proposed plan from Redwood:
- Block A (Tech deep-dive) — 90m: architecture, audit logs, runtime KV cache, model routing, telemetry (recommended attendees: Lead Infra Eng, AppSec, two engineering SMEs)
- Block B (Legal DPA review) — 30m: Product/Legal + your legal lead (we'll have our legal ops partner)
- Block C (Ops + pen test handoff) — 60m: Ops, CS, and pen vendor onboarding notes; runbook and test window coordination

Slot options (CEST):
Option 1: May 6 — Block A 14:00-15:30, Block B 16:00-16:30, Block C 16:45-17:45
Option 2: May 8 — Block A 10:00-11:30, Block B 11:45-12:15, Block C 12:30-13:30

How we prefer evidence: encrypted Drive folder + a short index CSV (see our redwood-soc2-overview.pdf attached for mapping). If you need a secure upload link or an SFTP drop, we can provide both.

If those windows work I will send calendar invites with the internal GDocs: agenda per block + pre-reads. Also flagging Ben for pen-test specifics and Lauren for DPA/legal.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-soc2-overview.pdf (stub)
From: Aisha Morgan <aisha.morgan@northernbank.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: security-team@northernbank.com
Date: 2029-04-21T08:36:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 / pen test / DPA review — scheduling and evidence handoff

Hi Karthik — option 1 on May 6 looks promising, but two notes: 1) our AppSec lead is EU-based and prefers a later slot (CEST after 15:00) and 2) our legal counsel is only available on May 8 early afternoon.

Could we do a hybrid: start Block A on May 6 at 15:30-17:00 CEST (shifted 1.5h), move Block B to May 8 12:00-12:30 CEST, and keep Block C as May 6 17:15-18:15 CEST? That keeps the tech + ops on the same day and legal separate.

For evidence: we'll upload the CSV inventory tomorrow evening to the drive link you provide.

Aisha
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Aisha Morgan <aisha.morgan@northernbank.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2029-04-21T10:02:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 / pen test / DPA review — scheduling and evidence handoff

Aisha — thanks for the constraints. We can do the hybrid plan. Confirming proposed schedule (CEST):
- May 6: Block A Tech deep-dive 15:30-17:00 CEST (90m) 
- May 6: Block C Ops + pen handoff 17:15-18:15 CEST (60m)
- May 8: Block B Legal DPA review 12:00-12:30 CEST (30m)

I'll send invites with separate agendas and a shared secure folder for evidence upload. For the pen test, Ben will share a short CSV of proposed vendor scoping items — can you confirm vendor name (if known) or we can keep it generic until you decide?

Thanks — Lauren
Manager, Compliance Programs — Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Morgan <aisha.morgan@northernbank.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, security-team@northernbank.com
Date: 2029-04-22T09:10:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 / pen test / DPA review — scheduling and evidence handoff

Lauren — that schedule is fine. Vendor is ThermionSec (we're still finalizing engagement but they will run the test). Uploading the CSV now (will look like the template).

One ask for the tech session: can you include a short segment (15m) on how Redwood handles fallback routing and model variant rollbacks during an incident? That's a key check for our resilience controls.

Aisha
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Aisha Morgan <aisha.morgan@northernbank.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com

Invites & pre-reads are going out shortly. If you need the encryption key or SFTP details for the evidence upload, reply and we'll share. Looking forward to the walkthrough.
